preconditions.description: The number of brains in the final nervous system is an integer between 2 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == n and all(p in range(1, k) for k, p in enumerate(stdin.split()[1:], start=2))
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n-1 integers, where the k-th integer (for k from 2 to n) is a parent brain index p_k in the range [1, k-1].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(max(1, max(1 + (k - 1 - parent_count) for parent_count in [sum(1 for _ in range(1, k) if parent == p) for p in range(1, k)]))) for k in range(2, n + 1)]
postconditions.description: For each brain k (from 2 to n), the output is the maximum latency from brain 1 to brain k after brain k is added. The latency of brain k is defined as 1 plus the maximum latency of its parent brain's subtree size before its addition.
The output contains exactly n-1 space-separated integers, one for each brain added (from brain 2 to brain n).
